scoring_guide.title: How Investment Guide scoring works
scoring_guide.intro: Point-sum shortlist for SP Conversion / SSP Conversion investment on Units and Characters (Attack Type / Defense Type / Support Type). Units have separate SP and SSP boards; Characters use SP only. Criteria favor practical sortie tools (MAP Weapon, mobility follow-ups, weapon power) and a deep affinity Character pool over a single linked recommend. Minor Attack Type stats (HP, SSP EN) are upside-only — no floor punishment. Close letters still need a human look.
overrides: Each score factor adds points; the total becomes a letter, then a bucket (BEYOND THE TIME / Recommended / Solid / Situational / Niche). Units: Attack score 17+ earns S+ and BEYOND THE TIME. Defense Type Units need 18+, lasting ATK Down at Lv5+ (30%+), tank more than one hit (HP + Shield Defense / special DR / Unbreakable), plus Preemptive Strike or Support Defense coverage (unit SD kit or MOV 6). Support Type Units need 17+ with lasting DEF Down / pierce at Lv5+ (30%+). Characters: kit points stay absolute; within each Character Type, S+ is roughly the top 3% and S the top 8% (with an absolute A+ floor); A+ and below use role-relative point cutoffs. Defense Type Characters also need a Defense or Reaction band for BEYOND THE TIME.
Filter by Series, Tag, or Eternal Road Expert stage to compare Units and Characters that actually fit the same restriction.
This is a general investment ranking that can also help on Expert — not a dedicated Expert-clears ladder (kit quality should not collapse when one stage’s AI or stats shift).
gaps: Non-Ultimate UR Units are omitted for now — their kits are too unique for the shared SP Conversion / SSP Conversion criteria.
Ultimate Units stay on the board. Their series Advantage: Unit Ability is withheld from the base score and only applied when a Tag filter matches that Advantage series.
Letter cutoffs use separate scales for SP Conversion targets vs Ultimate Units, so Ultimate kits do not lock out Recommended for chip investment.
Character Recommended Units points use this list’s Unit letters (SP / SSP best).

Strategic Tag weights use UR roster frequency, but Tags that already appear on Expert restrictions are skipped here — Expert access covers that value (avoids double-counting as Expert and Tag lists converge).
Affinity Character pool counts SSR+ Characters with piloting-Tag / EX-pair affinity for the Unit (not Supporter amp %).

Unit Recommended Characters: official recommend only when Ranged/Melee/Awaken matches the Unit’s strongest non-MAP weapon (Defense Type Units skip specialty); then affinity Characters already on this guide with the same specialty match, filling up to 3 with SR/R — never pad with wrong-stat SSRs.
Character Recommended Units use a portfolio: top 3 Units graded A / A+ / S / S+ (SP or SSP best) — A/A+ = +1, S/S+ = +2, cap +2. B+ and below do not score.

Character kits add flat Conditional Ability / Initial MP bonuses on top of TraitType points; active skills are role-weighted (damage / range / survivability / mobility over MP; EN Charge / Save EN = 0).
UR Characters are omitted from the Character board (not SP Conversion targets; there are no Ultimate Characters).

Transform scores only when the alternate form unlocks deployable Terrain Capability, higher MOV, longer range, higher weapon power, or adds a MAP Weapon. Combat stats use the better of base/alt HP·DEF·ATK when the alt form improves those.

Attack Type HP and SSP Attack Type EN are upside-only; Defense Type HP/DEF floors are mild (−1) and the +2 HP band starts at 120k so survivability can create rank. ATK stays upside-only. Special defenses (I-field / DR / barrier) are presence bonuses beyond the shield mechanism. Defense Type BEYOND THE TIME also requires a hard-stage kit: tank more than one hit and Preemptive Strike or Support Defense coverage. Lasting ATK Down is Defense Type debuff strength (tank analog of Support DEF Down) and also counts as tank mitigation.
Support Type BEYOND THE TIME needs lasting DEF Down / pierce at Lv5+ (30%+) so MAP-padded kits stay Recommended.
Defense Type Characters need a Defense or Reaction band for BEYOND THE TIME — kit-only Durability Characters stay Recommended.
Units whose recommend Character is UR / Ultimate take a mild −1 dependence tax (still usable with lower-rarity Characters).
Unit Expert access bands are compressed so a small eligibility gap (e.g. 4 vs 6 stages) is not a free letter tier.
Terrain Capability extras need full affinity circle (Lv≥3); triangle Space/Atmospheric is a mild penalty, not a strength.
Acquisition (Unit Assembly / Development / Other) is a filter only — it does not change letter scores. Multi-select Acquisition (OR) can exclude Unit Assembly by picking Development + Other.
Limited-time Unit Assembly Supporter leader Tags: +1 per matched Tag on the kit, cap +2 (integer points only).

Character letters are hybrid within Character Type: S+ ≈ top 3% and S ≈ top 8% by kit total (absolute A+ floor); A+ and below use role-relative point cutoffs. Specialty tip for Ranged/Melee/Awaken caps at +5 (Attack/Support). Defense Type Characters score Defense/Reaction first; Ranged/Melee/Awaken are upside-only (cap +1).
Support Type debuff-kind scoring uses base weapon range — SSP range enhance does not invent Range-5 credit for Range-4 kits.
Support Type weapon_bonus is capped at +1 (Higher-range style bonuses stay Attack-flavored).

Max Vigor −1 is for guns that require Max Vigor to fire and outpower every unrestricted option (Twin Satellite–class). On SSP, Custom Core (…90) is the bypass — SSP power enhance on a still-gated SP weapon does not re-apply that −1.
Multi damage-type (+2): any weapon (including MAP) whose WeaponAttribute combines Beam / Physical / Special. Not limited to Barbatos Lupus / Rex — those were an early allowlist placeholder.
Community votes nudge the displayed total by at most ±2 (IP-limited). Objective kit score remains primary; kits with no votes stay at 0 nudge.
Combat actions: first Support Defense +1 is Durability/Support identity (+2). A second distinct SD +1 family is extra +1 (3 SD). Support Attack +1 stays +2 on Support. Cap 4.
Transform combat stats: when the alt form raises HP, DEF, or ATK vs base, score the better of each (no unit-id allowlist).
GN Field / Positron Reflector score like other damage-reduction kits (no name exclude).
Multi combat specialty (+1): strongest attack uses 2+ of Ranged / Melee / Awaken (separate from damage type).
Close letters still need a human look.

pilot_letter_hybrid.note: Within each Character Type: top ~3% = S+ (BEYOND THE TIME), top ~8% = S or better (Recommended). Must meet absolute A+ floor. A and below stay on absolute role cutoffs; absolute S/S+ outside the percentile window demote to A+.
